name: note_max_words
why: The method owner's limit for a sticky note: at most 50 to 60 words

name: assessor_wave
why: Implementation-assessor agents run at once; each wave finishes before the next starts

name: matcher_rounds
why: Search rounds when proposing links: the script's terms, then the matcher's extra terms once

name: more_terms_per_box
why: Search words a matcher may ask for per box for the second round; the first ones are kept

name: terms_per_box
why: Search terms the script makes from one box in round 1: the objects and systems it names, its nouns, its verbs, then pairs of words

name: hits_per_search
why: Results asked of search_metadata per search; more are a gap in the brief

name: candidates_per_box
why: Candidates a matcher brief shows per box; the best by how many terms found them

name: automations_per_object
why: Automations that use one object a matcher brief lists

name: dependency_rows_per_component
why: Dependency rows per linked component in an assessor pack; the rest are counted and the pack says so

name: definition_chars_per_component
why: Characters of one definition kept in a pack; a longer one is cut and the pack says so

name: boxes_per_run
why: Boxes one run assesses; a larger scope is narrowed at kickoff

name: note_gap_px
why: Pixels between a box and its sticky note

name: note_size_px
why: Width and height Elements gives a new note; used to keep notes clear of boxes
